IC1: Clinical and radiologic diagnosis of primary knee osteoarthritis [AND] (Kellgren & Lawrence I, II or III);
IC2: Capability to understand the Informed Consent Form;
IC3: Chronic pain for at least 3 months prior to inclusion, measured by VAS. (VAS 4 or above);
IC4: [NOT] Absence of skin injures [OR], infections [OR] or tumor in the target knee;
IC5: Availability to comply with the visits.
